location: INT. HOVERCRAFT - INFIRMARY, INT. NEO'S ROOM, INT. HOVERCRAFT
summary: Neo wakes up in the infirmary with his body pierced by needles connected to a device. DOZER and MORPHEUS are operating on him to rebuild his atrophied muscles. MORPHEUS explains that Neo's eyes hurt because he has never used them before. Later, Neo wakes up in his room feeling better and examines his physical changes, specifically a futuristic IV in his forearm and a large outlet at the base of his skull. When he begins to panic, MORPHEUS enters and tells him that the year is closer to 2197 than 1997. MORPHEUS then invites Neo to follow him to see the ship.

what_changes.before: Believes the year is 1997 and is unaware of his physical modifications.
what_changes.after: Learns the year is much closer to 2197 and is aware of the grafted outlets on his body.

what_changes.before: Body is pierced with needles and muscles are atrophied.
what_changes.after: Wakes up feeling better after the procedure.

objects_that_matter: large outlet in base of skull

event_hint.one_line: Neo recovers from being unplugged and learns the true date and his physical state.
